item.content:encoded:
Field Notes syntax checklist — every supported feature, exercised in one post.

If anything below renders wrong, the syntax is broken. This is the live test surface for the markdown pipeline: parser, React renderer, RSS feed, plain-text feed.

Headings

ATX form, 1–6 leading #s. Levels 1–4 render as distinct visual styles; 5 and 6 collapse to h4.

h1 — gold-ticket section stamp

h2 — section break with bottom border

h3 — sub-section, no border

h4 — small uppercase mono label

Inline markdown

bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code, link text, https://example.com, bold with italic inside for nesting. An inline image embedded in prose: look at this sitting in the middle of a sentence.

Blockquote

A single-line blockquote with > prefix and inline markdown inside. Lines are joined with spaces per CommonMark soft-break semantics.

Code block

The body is a JS template literal, so the triple backticks below are escaped with `.

# Fenced code block, with a language hint
curl -sL "https://www.robust.computer/rss.xml"

Lists

Unordered — consecutive - or * lines become one block:

  • one
  • two
  • three

Ordered — consecutive 1. or 1) lines become one block:

  1. first
  2. second
  3. third

Mixed markers in the same run split into two blocks (intentional):

  • unordered
  • another unordered
  1. ordered
  2. another ordered

Image (standalone)

A line that is JUST an image becomes its own block — Figure on the slug page, <img> in the RSS feed, [image: alt] placeholder in the plain-text feed.
